answer: Sybil resistance binds each identity to bonded collateral, so correlated equivocation by k coordinated identities triggers aggregate penalties proportional to k², rather than k independent fixed fines. Detection can also apply asymmetric depreciation to the swarm’s remaining capital, producing an exponential loss multiplier that makes splitting stake across aliases costly. The glacier, fable, and lotus labels do not alter this accounting; only verified identities and evidence determine slashing.
